summary: Closed the loop on the snapshot-cadence correction. A source-only interpretation (no experiment id, conclusion explained, no defect judgment) answers all four gaps the correction opened, stating the refined premise and its limits: shouldSnapshot compares the log's last index with the last snapshot index at or above SnapshotThreshold, but runSnapshots evaluates it only when a randomized timeout of up to SnapshotInterval expires (snapshot.go:71-95 and 107-121, config.go:331-342), so the committed range can pass the threshold and keep growing - measured as 12001 entries above an absent snapshot against a threshold of 8192 with no snapshot taken (receipt 0cb30b6bf8874d479b83653bd4e6c553, events 36, 38 and 41, cited as non-supporting corroboration). It records that the correction affects how tight the automatic bound is rather than the replay mechanism, that the older accounts' cadence wording is superseded while their conclusions stand, and that no steady-state or overshoot measurement is offered. The experiment-cited defect account is re-appended in the same batch so the question's current account keeps its violated/asserted judgment while citing knowledge revision 2. Both investigations now have coherent records with no open gaps, every cited claim verified against the retained receipts, and reproducibility coverage on every pair of cases.
